_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. API keys are NEVER stored here - each account names the environment variable that holds its key. Prices are USD per 1M tokens; check your provider's current pricing page and update them. longContext: when a request's prompt (input + cached input) reaches thresholdTokens, ALL tokens in that request are billed at the longContext rates.
_budgetUSD: Optional overall project budget in USD. The usage meter warns before a message would go over it. Set to 0 to turn it off.

accounts.name: Claude (your plan)
accounts._comment: Uses the Claude Code CLI on this computer and your Claude subscription - no API key. Install Claude Code and sign in once (run `claude`, then /login). Personal use only. To use an API key instead, set provider to "anthropic", add "apiKeyEnv": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" and pricing {inputPerM: 4, outputPerM: 20, cachedInputPerM: 0.2, cacheWritePerM: 5}, and set the Claude bot's model to "claude-opus-5-5".

accounts.name: Free (no usage)
accounts._comment: Canned replies generated on this server. No API key, no Claude/xAI calls, always $0.
